split_policy: Chronological 60/20/20 by step; complete steps stay in one split; thresholds selected on validation only.
seed_stability_warning: Each run retrains a separate Isolation Forest on a different seeded sample. This is policy sensitivity evidence, not a repeated evaluation of the exact deployed model artifact.

score_definitions.hybrid: Configured Isolation Forest/rule weighted score, clipped. Signals absent from PaySim are not simulated in this evaluation.
score_definitions.production_policy: The configured low boundary marks MEDIUM-or-HIGH and the medium boundary marks HIGH; both are diagnostics, not approvals to deploy or recalibrate.

validation_threshold_selection.policy: For model-only and hybrid score, select the training-normal quantile candidate with highest validation F2; ties prefer precision then lower false-positive rate.

hybrid_medium_or_higher_cutoff.interpretation: Rows scoring at or above the configured low threshold are MEDIUM-or-HIGH. Test results are diagnostic only and do not constitute calibration.

hybrid_high_decision_cutoff.interpretation: Rows scoring at or above the configured medium boundary are HIGH under the runtime policy. Test results are diagnostic only and do not constitute calibration.

limitations: Synthetic PaySim labels and synthetic transaction features only.
Device, IP, SIM-swap, customer-deviation, unusual-hour, velocity, and frequency signals are absent and are not simulated as positive.
Recipient history is derived only from sampled prior steps, which may differ from full production history.
Each seed uses a model fitted on that seed's earlier training period; this is not an evaluation of the current runtime artifacts.
Wilson confidence intervals describe per-test-set proportions only and do not account for temporal clustering or seed variation.
Runtime model artifacts and thresholds are unchanged.
